newsitem.title: USA: Rawlings to buy Canadian equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Rawlings to buy Canadian equipment maker.

text.p: Rawlings Sporting Goods Inc said Wednesday it will pay an undicslosed price to acquire Daignault Rolland Cie Ltee, a hockey and baseball equipment manufacturer in Montreal.
Rawlings said Daignault posts annual revenues of about $5 million, and it expected to be accretive to Rawlings' earnings in fiscal 1998.
Giles Daignault, Daignault's president, will manage the division once the deal closes in late April, Rawlings said.
Rawlings supplies team sports equipment and apparel.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Wednesday at 9-1/2.
